import json
from pathlib import Path

# Load existing evidence
evidence_path = Path('mira/data/h2_evidence_merged.json')
with open(evidence_path) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

existing = data.get('evidence', [])
print(f'Existing records: {len(existing)}')

# Get existing material keys for comparison
existing_keys = {}
for r in existing:
    key = r.get('material_name', '').lower()
    hee = r.get('hee_index', 0)
    if key not in existing_keys or hee < existing_keys[key]:
        existing_keys[key] = hee

# NASA Table 2 values for under-conservative materials (worst-case values)
# These are the actual NASA TM-2016-218602 values we need to add
corrections = [
    # (name, hee_index, band, notes)
    ('Inconel 706', 0.46, 'extreme', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2 - worst case'),
    ('Nitronic 50', 0.62, 'severe', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2'),
    ('Astroloy', 0.62, 'severe', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2'),
    ('304N Stainless Steel', 0.66, 'severe', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2'),
    ('21-6-9 Stainless Steel', 0.66, 'severe', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2'),
    ('Nitronic 40', 0.68, 'severe', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2 - base alloy'),
    ('Waspaloy', 0.68, 'severe', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2'),
    ('347 Stainless Steel', 0.76, 'high', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2'),
    ('A-286', 0.77, 'high', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2'),
    ('310 Stainless Steel', 0.85, 'high', 'NASA TM-2016-218602 Table 2'),
]

added = 0
for name, hee, band, notes in corrections:
    existing_hee = existing_keys.get(name.lower(), float('inf'))
    if hee < existing_hee:
        record = {
            'evidence_id': f'NASA-TM-CORR-{added+1:03d}',
            'material_name': name,
            'material_key': name,
            'material_family': 'see_alias',
            'test_conditions': {
                'pressure_mpa': 68.9,
                'temperature_c': 24,
                'specimen_type': 'notched',
                'reference_gas': 'helium'
            },
            'metrics': {'nts_ratio': hee},
            'hee_index': hee,
            'hee_band': band,
            'source': {
                'document': 'NASA/TM-2016-218602',
                'table': 'Table 2',
                'notes': notes
            },
            'he_mechanism': 'HEE'
        }
        existing.append(record)
        added += 1
        print(f'Added: {name} (HEE={hee} {band}) - was {existing_hee:.2f}')
    else:
        print(f'Skip:  {name} (HEE={hee} {band}) - already have {existing_hee:.2f}')

print(f'\\nAdded {added} correction records')
print(f'Total records now: {len(existing)}')

# Update metadata and save
data['total_records'] = len(existing)
with open(evidence_path, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)

print(f'Saved to {evidence_path}')
" 2>&1

The user is asking for my thoughts on comparing the current BoundState simplified H2 engine vs the MIRA_V2 full-featured engine. Let me think about this carefully. Current BoundState (Simplified H2 Engine)
engine_simple.py - ~570 lines
Does ONE thing well: material → HEE verdict
Tiered matching (exact → alias → alloy number → fuzzy → family)
Worst-case selection for safety
Condition parsing from query string
91% pass rate on NASA Table 2
No database dependencies (JSON file)
No LLM dependencies
Fast, deterministic, testable
MIRA_V2 (Full Evidence-First Engine)
query_engine_v2.py - orchestrator for full NL queries
PostgreSQL for MUA precedents + test data
FAISS indexes for semantic search
LLM integration (Ollama/Haiku) for answer generation
Constraint parsing from natural language
Boundary checking against BOK limits
Multiple evidence sources (MUA, test data, BOK, MAPTIS)
Much more complex, many dependencies
Trade-offs: The simplified engine is:
Focused on H2 embrittlement ONLY
Deterministic and testable
No infrastructure dependencies
Fast (sub-millisecond)
Easy to understand and maintain
The MIRA_V2 engine is:
Multi-domain (O2, H2, flammability, etc.)
Natural language capable
Evidence-rich (cites MUAs, test data)
LLM-enhanced explanations
Requires PostgreSQL, FAISS, LLM service
More complex failure modes
My recommendation: For the H2 Knowledge Twin specifically, the simplified approach is actually BETTER because:
H2 embrittlement is a well-defined problem with clear HEE index data
The decision process is straightforward: material selection relies on worst-case HEE verdict
Introducing LLM complexity would only add unnecessary overhead without improving accuracy
NASA Table 2 remains the definitive reference for material compatibility
For broader material compatibility investigations, the MIRA_V2 architecture offers significant advantages. Complex queries requiring nuanced analysis, such as exploring material approvals across different pressure environments or understanding detailed failure mechanisms, benefit from its rich semantic search and LLM-powered explanatory capabilities. These approaches are complementary, not competing - each engineered to solve specific knowledge retrieval challenges with precision and efficiency. The critical question centers on understanding the user's precise technical requirements and matching them with the most appropriate analytical framework.
Good question. Let me share my perspective on the trade-offs:
Simplified H2 Engine (Current)
What it does:
Material name → HEE index → Verdict
~570 lines, JSON evidence file
No external dependencies (no DB, no LLM, no FAISS)
Strengths:
Fast (~1ms response)
Deterministic and testable
91% accuracy on NASA Table 2
Easy to maintain and debug
Worst-case selection is correct for safety
Limitations:
H2-only (not O2, flammability, etc.)
No natural language beyond condition parsing
No "why" explanations beyond rationale string
No MUA precedent citations
MIRA_V2 Full Engine
What it does:
Natural language → Constraint parsing → SQL + Semantic search → LLM synthesis → Evidence-based answer
Strengths:
Multi-domain (O2, H2, flammability, corrosion)
Cites MUA precedents and test data
LLM explains decisions in context
Handles complex queries ("aluminum in oxygen at 3000 psi")
Limitations:
Requires PostgreSQL, FAISS, LLM service
More failure modes
Slower (~2-5s with LLM)
Harder to test deterministically
My Take
They solve different problems:
Question Type	Best Approach
"Is Inconel 718 hydrogen compatible?"	Simplified - HEE lookup
"Can I use aluminum in oxygen at 3000 psi?"	MIRA_V2 - Boundary check + BOK
"What materials were approved for SLS hydrogen tanks?"	MIRA_V2 - MUA search
"Explain why this material failed"	MIRA_V2 - Semantic + LLM
For pure H2 embrittlement queries, the simplified engine is actually better - adding LLM doesn't improve accuracy, it just adds latency and complexity. The NASA Table 2 data IS the answer. Question for you: Is the goal to:
Keep H2 simple and integrate MIRA_V2 for broader queries?
Port MIRA_V2 to replace the simplified H2 engine entirely?

MIRA_V2 → Current MIRA: Porting Guidance
Executive Summary
MIRA_V2 is a more mature, production-grade system with significant advantages. Recommend selective porting of key components rather than wholesale replacement.

Aspect	Current MIRA	MIRA_V2	Recommendation
H2 Engine	Simple lookup (371 records)	Evidence-first + MUA precedents	Keep current - simpler, works
Material Matching	Static aliases (900+)	Fuzzy + DB-driven	Port fuzzy logic
MUA Precedents	None	6,181 parsed MUAs	PORT - critical evidence
FAISS Indexes	Small H2 BOK	3 indexes (211 MB total)	PORT - massive evidence boost
LLM Guardrails	None	Hard safety rules	PORT - essential for safety
Unit Tracking	None	Unit reliability field	PORT - safety-critical
What to Port (Priority Order)
1. MUA Precedent Integration - HIGH PRIORITY
Why: 6,181 historic NASA material decisions are gold-standard evidence.

What exists in MIRA_V2:

bok.mua_precedents table with parsed decisions
Scripts to ingest MUAs: scripts/load_muas_enhanced.py
Environment classification from rationale text
Port to current:

# Add to engine_simple.py query() method
# Step 0.5: Check MUA precedents FIRST
mua_result = self._check_mua_precedents(material, environment="hydrogen")
if mua_result and mua_result.determination == "DENIED":
    return H2Result(verdict=Verdict.PROHIBITED, rationale=f"MUA {mua_result.id} denied")

Effort: Medium (need DB schema + ingestion scripts)

2. FAISS Semantic Search - HIGH PRIORITY
Why: Current engine only searches 371 records. MIRA_V2 has 130,661 MAPTIS test records indexed.

What exists in MIRA_V2:

src/semantic_search.py - Unified FAISS interface
src/semantic_evidence.py - Content fetching
Pre-built indexes in data/faiss_indexes/
Port approach:

# Add as fallback tier in _find_matches()
# Tier 6: FAISS semantic search (if no structured matches)
if not matches:
    faiss_matches = self._semantic_search(query, top_k=20)
    for doc in faiss_matches:
        if doc.score >= 0.68:  # HIGH confidence threshold
            add_match(...)

Effort: Medium (FAISS already in current MIRA, need to wire to H2)

3. LLM Decision Guardrails - HIGH PRIORITY
Why: Prevents LLM from hallucinating unsafe recommendations.

What exists in MIRA_V2 (llm_decision_guardrails.py):

HARD_RULES = [
    "Only cite evidence that appears in provided context",
    "Never infer oxygen compatibility from air/vacuum tests",
    "Never guess units - flag as NEEDS_REVIEW",
    "BOK prohibitions override MUA approvals"
]

Port to current: Add as system prompt rules when generating rationale text.

Effort: Low (copy system prompt templates)

4. Unit Reliability Tracking - MEDIUM PRIORITY
Why: Prevents unsafe decisions when units are ambiguous.

What exists in MIRA_V2:

class NumericLimit:
    value: float
    unit: str
    unit_reliability: str  # "ok" | "missing" | "ambiguous"

Port approach: Add to H2Result:

@dataclass
class H2Result:
    # ... existing fields ...
    pressure_reliability: str = "ok"  # Track if pressure units confirmed
    temperature_reliability: str = "ok"

Effort: Low

5. Environment Classification - MEDIUM PRIORITY
Why: MIRA_V2 correctly filters non-H2 evidence from H2 queries.

What exists in MIRA_V2:

def classify_environment(rationale_text: str) -> EnvironmentClass:
    """Detect if evidence is oxygen/hydrogen/air/vacuum."""
    if any(kw in text for kw in ["hydrogen", "h2", "gh2", "lh2"]):
        return EnvironmentClass.HYDROGEN
    ...

Port approach: Filter evidence by he_mechanism field (already in data):

# In _find_matches()
if record.he_mechanism == "IHE":  # Internal Hydrogen Embrittlement
    # Different physics than HEE - may need separate handling

Effort: Low (field exists, need filtering logic)

6. 2D Relevance Scoring - LOW PRIORITY (nice to have)
Why: Combines semantic similarity + authority to answer.

What exists in MIRA_V2 (answer_authority.py):

Prohibition detection (40% weight)
Limit specificity (30% weight)
Standard authority (20% weight)
Query alignment (10% weight)
Recommendation: Defer unless current engine accuracy is insufficient.

What NOT to Port
Component	Why Skip
Full query_engine_v2.py	Over-engineered for current needs
Constraint interpreter	Current condition parsing works fine
PostgreSQL schema	Current JSON evidence is simpler
GMI API structure	Current FastAPI routes work
Haiku ingestion	One-time cost already paid
Recommended Porting Sequence
Phase 1 (Week 1): Safety Foundations
├── Port LLM guardrails to system prompts
├── Add unit reliability tracking to H2Result
└── Add environment filtering to _find_matches()

Phase 2 (Week 2-3): Evidence Expansion  
├── Ingest MUA precedents to database
├── Add MUA precedent check to query()
└── Wire FAISS semantic search as fallback tier

Phase 3 (Week 4): Validation
├── Run MIRA_V2 benchmark suite (30 queries)
├── Compare accuracy before/after
└── Document gaps for H2-specific optimizations

Code Integration Points
Where to add MUA check (engine_simple.py:query()):

def query(self, material: str, ...) -> H2Result:
    self._ensure_loaded()
    
    # NEW: Check MUA precedents first (evidence-first philosophy)
    mua_evidence = self._check_mua_precedents(effective_material)
    
    # Existing flow
    matches = self._find_matches(effective_material)
    
    # NEW: Merge MUA evidence into matches
    if mua_evidence:
        matches.extend(mua_evidence)

Where to add FAISS search (engine_simple.py:_find_matches()):

# After Tier 5 (family fallback)
if not matches and self._faiss_index is not None:
    semantic_matches = self._faiss_search(norm_query, top_k=20)
    for doc in semantic_matches:
        if doc.score >= 0.68:
            add_match(self._doc_to_evidence(doc), "semantic", doc.score)

H2-Specific Gaps in MIRA_V2
MIRA_V2 acknowledges these are NOT yet implemented:

Hydrogen embrittlement severity scoring
SCC (stress corrosion cracking) risk weighting
GH2 vs LH2 regime distinction
High-strength steel threshold warnings
Material family H2 compatibility matrices
Current MIRA already handles #4 and #5 via the simplified engine's worst-case selection.

Bottom Line
Port the data and guardrails, not the architecture.

Current MIRA's simplified engine is cleaner and more maintainable. MIRA_V2's value is in:

6,181 MUA precedents (evidence)
130,661 MAPTIS records (evidence via FAISS)
LLM safety rules (guardrails)
Don't port the 844-line query_engine_v2.py - its complexity isn't needed when you have a working 668-line engine_simple.py.

MIRA_V2 Porting Strategy
Key Decision: Port Data & Guardrails, NOT Architecture
The simplified H2 engine (engine_simple.py, 668 lines) is better than MIRA_V2's complex orchestrator for H2 queries because:
Deterministic and testable
Fast (~1ms vs 2-5s with LLM)
Worst-case selection is correct for safety
What to Port from MIRA_V2
HIGH Priority
Component	Value	Effort
MUA Precedents	6,181 historic NASA decisions	Medium
FAISS Indexes	130,661 MAPTIS records searchable	Medium
LLM Guardrails	Safety rules for explanations	Low
MEDIUM Priority
Component	Value	Effort
Unit Reliability	Flag ambiguous units	Low
Environment Classification	Filter non-H2 evidence	Low
Skip (Don't Port)
Component	Why
query_engine_v2.py	Over-engineered, 844 lines
PostgreSQL schema	JSON evidence works fine
Constraint interpreter	Current parsing works

def query(self, material: str, ...) -> H2Result:
    # NEW: Check MUA precedents first
    mua_evidence = self._check_mua_precedents(material)

    # Existing flow
    matches = self._find_matches(material)

    # Merge MUA evidence
    if mua_evidence:
        matches.extend(mua_evidence)
2. Add FAISS Fallback to _find_matches()

# After Tier 5 (family fallback)
if not matches and self._faiss_index:
    semantic_matches = self._faiss_search(query, top_k=20)
    for doc in semantic_matches:
        if doc.score >= 0.68:
            add_match(self._doc_to_evidence(doc), "semantic", doc.score)

Phased Approach

Previous: H2 Evidence Data Quality Analysis
Root Cause Analysis
The evidence database has 361 records from 3 sources:
h2 evidence db.json (Claude Desktop, 84 records)
h2_evidence.json (extract h2.py, 117 records)
NASA/TM-2016-218602 Table 2 extended (92 records)
Key Finding: The Conflicts Are Mostly Legitimate
The audit identified 9 materials with entries differing by >0.1 HEE index. Analysis shows:
Material	Variation Cause	Valid?
K-Monel	Heat treatment (annealed=0.73 vs aged=0.45)	Yes
1042 Steel	Heat treatment (normalized=0.75 vs Q&T=0.22)	Yes
Ti-6Al-4V	Pressure + heat treatment (34-69 MPa, ann vs STA)	Yes
304L/316L	Different pressures (same source, same condition)	Yes
MA 956	Orientation (longitudinal=0.58 vs transverse=0.34)	Yes
The data doesn't "suck" - it reflects real material science: HEE behavior varies with test conditions.
Why the Engine Already Handles This Correctly
The engine uses worst-case evidence selection (implemented in previous fix):
For MA 754: Returns extreme (0.19) not small (0.94)
For K-Monel: Returns extreme (0.45) not high (0.73)
This is the safe, conservative approach for safety-critical applications
Recommended Actions
Option A: Keep Current Behavior (Recommended)
The current worst-case selection is correct for safety. No data changes needed. Pros:
Safety-conservative (always assumes worst case)
Preserves valuable condition-specific data
No risk of data loss
Cons:
May be overly conservative for specific known conditions
Option B: Add Source Priority (Alternative)
Add priority weighting: NASA Table 2 > Other NASA > Sandia > Other sources Would require:
Add priority field to each evidence record
Modify engine to prefer higher-priority sources
Re-run ingestion with priority tags
Option C: Condition-Aware Matching (Future Enhancement)
Match query conditions (pressure, heat treatment) to evidence conditions. Would require:
Parse user's material condition from query
Filter evidence to matching conditions
Fall back to worst-case when conditions unknown

New message (with explanation):

# Build explanation based on what differs between evidence
diff_reasons = []
if worst_ev.heat_treatment != dom_ev.heat_treatment:
    diff_reasons.append("heat treatment")
if worst_ev.pressure_mpa != dom_ev.pressure_mpa:
    diff_reasons.append("test pressure")
if worst_ev.orientation != dom_ev.orientation:
    diff_reasons.append("grain orientation")

reason_text = ", ".join(diff_reasons) if diff_reasons else "test conditions"

warnings.append(
    f"Evidence shows {dom_ev.hee_band.value} to {worst_ev.hee_band.value} HEE depending on {reason_text}. "
    f"Using conservative {worst_ev.hee_band.value} rating for safety. "
    f"Specify exact conditions for a more precise assessment."
)
Change 2: Also trigger warning for smaller gaps (severity >= 1)
Current: Only warns when severity gap >= 2 (e.g., negligible vs high) New: Warn when severity gap >= 1 (e.g., small vs high) This ensures users see the explanation whenever there's meaningful variation.

/**
 * Page Help Component
 * Displays help information for each MIRA tab/page
 */

import { HelpCircle, BookOpen, Lightbulb, Target, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";

export interface PageHelpContent {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  whatItDoes: string[];
  howToUse: string[];
  useCases: string[];
  tips?: string[];
  relatedPages?: { name: string; path: string }[];
  apiEndpoint?: string;
}

interface PageHelpProps {
  content: PageHelpContent;
  className?: string;
}

export function PageHelp({ content, className = "" }: PageHelpProps) {
  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="icon"
          className={`h-8 w-8 rounded-full ${className}`}
          title="Help - What does this page do?"
        >
          <HelpCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors" />
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>

      <DialogContent className="max-w-3xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="text-2xl flex items-center gap-2">
            <BookOpen className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" />
            {content.title}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription className="text-base">
            {content.description}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-6 mt-4">
          {/* What It Does Section */}
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
              <Target className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-500" />
              What This Page Does
            </h3>
            <ul className="space-y-2">
              {content.whatItDoes.map((item, index) => (
                <li key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{item}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>

          <Separator />

          {/* How To Use Section */}
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
              <Lightbulb className="h-5 w-5 text-yellow-500" />
              How To Use
            </h3>
            <ol className="space-y-2 list-decimal list-inside">
              {content.howToUse.map((step, index) => (
                <li key={index} className="text-sm text-muted-foreground pl-2">
                  {step}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
          </div>

          <Separator />

          {/* Use Cases Section */}
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-3">
              Example Use Cases
            </h3>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {content.useCases.map((useCase, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="bg-muted/50 p-3 rounded-lg">
                  <p className="text-sm italic text-muted-foreground">"{useCase}"</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tips Section (Optional) */}
          {content.tips && content.tips.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <Separator />
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-3">
                  Pro Tips
                </h3>
                <ul className="space-y-2">
                  {content.tips.map((tip, index) => (
                    <li key={index} className="text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-start gap-2">
                      <span className="text-primary font-bold">•</span>
                      {tip}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* API Endpoint (Optional) */}
          {content.apiEndpoint && (
            <>
              <Separator />
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">
                  API Endpoint
                </h3>
                <code className="block bg-muted p-2 rounded text-sm font-mono">
                  {content.apiEndpoint}
                </code>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Related Pages (Optional) */}
          {content.relatedPages && content.relatedPages.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <Separator />
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-3">
                  Related Pages
                </h3>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {content.relatedPages.map((page, index) => (
                    <Badge key={index} variant="outline" className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-primary/10">
                      <a href={page.path}>{page.name}</a>
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/**
 * Compact version for tight spaces
 */
export function PageHelpCompact({ content }: PageHelpProps) {
  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <button
          className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors"
          title="What does this page do?"
        >
          <HelpCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
      </DialogTrigger>

      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{content.title}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{content.description}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-semibold mb-2">What it does:</h4>
            <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">
              {content.whatItDoes.slice(0, 3).map((item, i) => (
                <li key={i}>• {item}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { PageHelp } from '@/components/PageHelp'
import helpContent from '@/config/helpContent'
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  XCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  Flame,
  Droplet,
  Search,
  Loader2,
  Sparkles
} from 'lucide-react'

const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000'

// Rating display configuration
const RATING_CONFIG: Record<string, {
  label: string
  icon: typeof CheckCircle2
  color: string
  bgColor: string
  borderColor: string
  description: string
}> = {
  'A': {
    label: 'Excellent',
    icon: CheckCircle2,
    color: 'text-green-600',
    bgColor: 'bg-green-50',
    borderColor: 'border-green-500',
    description: 'Approved, high heritage'
  },
  'B': {
    label: 'Good',
    icon: CheckCircle2,
    color: 'text-blue-600',
    bgColor: 'bg-blue-50',
    borderColor: 'border-blue-500',
    description: 'Approved, moderate heritage'
  },
  'C': {
    label: 'Fair',
    icon: AlertTriangle,
    color: 'text-yellow-600',
    bgColor: 'bg-yellow-50',
    borderColor: 'border-yellow-500',
    description: 'Approved, limited heritage'
  },
  'D': {
    label: 'Poor',
    icon: AlertTriangle,
    color: 'text-orange-600',
    bgColor: 'bg-orange-50',
    borderColor: 'border-orange-500',
    description: 'Conditionally approved'
  },
  'X': {
    label: 'Fail',
    icon: XCircle,
    color: 'text-red-600',
    bgColor: 'bg-red-50',
    borderColor: 'border-red-500',
    description: 'Not approved'
  },
  'U': {
    label: 'Unknown',
    icon: HelpCircle,
    color: 'text-gray-600',
    bgColor: 'bg-gray-50',
    borderColor: 'border-gray-500',
    description: 'Rating not available'
  }
}

interface Material {
  material_key: string
  material_name: string
  material_designation?: string
  o2_rating?: string
  h2_rating?: string
  flamm_rating?: string
  corr_rating?: string
  scc_rating?: string
  tvs_rating?: string
  tox_rating?: string
  fs_rating?: string
  score?: number
  snippet?: string
}

interface BOKResult {
  rank: number
  relevance_score: number
  text: string
  source: string
  section: string
  page?: number | null
  tags: string[]
}

interface HybridQueryResponse {
  status: string
  query: string
  timestamp: string
  answer?: string
  explanation?: string
  deterministic_decision?: string
  decision_source?: string
  decision_rationale?: string
  evidence_summary: {
    mua_precedents_found: number
    test_results_found: number
    requirements_evaluated: number
    semantic_results_found: number
    high_confidence_semantic: number
  }
  constraints?: Record<string, unknown>
  decisions?: Array<{
    decision: string
    confidence: string
    reasoning: string
    citations: string[]
  }>
  sql_evidence?: {
    mua_precedents: unknown[]
    test_results: unknown[]
  }
  semantic_evidence?: {
    total_results: number
    results: Array<{
      text: string
      source: string
      score: number
      metadata?: unknown
    }>
  }
  insufficient_data: boolean
  error?: string
}

export default function KnowledgeTwins() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'browse' | 'ask'>('browse')
  const [activeFluid, setActiveFluid] = useState<'oxygen' | 'hydrogen'>('oxygen')
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<Material[]>([])
  const [bokResults, setBokResults] = useState<BOKResult[]>([])
  const [hybridResponse, setHybridResponse] = useState<HybridQueryResponse | null>(null)
  const [llmProvider, setLlmProvider] = useState<'ollama' | 'haiku'>('ollama')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (!query.trim()) return

    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    setMaterials([])
    setBokResults([])

    try {
      // Call BOTH endpoints in parallel
      const [bokResponse, materialResponse] = await Promise.all([
        // BOK standards search
        fetch(`${API_URL}/api/v1/${activeFluid === 'oxygen' ? 'o2' : 'h2'}/search-bok`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            query,
            k: 10
          })
        }),
        // Material search
        fetch(`${API_URL}/api/search`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            query,
            top_k: 50
          })
        })
      ])

      if (!bokResponse.ok || !materialResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error('Search failed')
      }

      const bokData = await bokResponse.json()
      const materialData = await materialResponse.json()

      console.log('BOK Response:', bokData)
      console.log('Material Response:', materialData)

      setBokResults(bokData.results || [])
      setMaterials(materialData.results || [])

    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Search failed')
      console.error('Search error:', err)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleAsk = async () => {
    if (!query.trim()) return

    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    setHybridResponse(null)
    setMaterials([])
    setBokResults([])

    try {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/query/hybrid`,
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            query: query,
            enable_semantic: true,
            llm_provider: llmProvider
          })
        }
      )

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Question failed')
      }

      const data = await response.json()
      console.log('Hybrid Query Response:', data)
      setHybridResponse(data)

    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Question failed')
      console.error('Ask error:', err)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // Group materials by rating
  const groupedMaterials = materials.reduce((acc, material) => {
    const ratingField = activeFluid === 'oxygen' ? 'o2_rating' : 'h2_rating'
    const rawRating = material[ratingField as keyof Material] as string | undefined
    const rating = (rawRating === 'No data' || !rawRating) ? 'U' : rawRating

    if (!acc[rating]) {
      acc[rating] = []
    }
    acc[rating].push(material)

    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, Material[]>)

  // Sort ratings: A -> B -> C -> D -> X -> U
  const ratingOrder = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'X', 'U']
  const sortedRatings = ratingOrder.filter(rating => groupedMaterials[rating])

  const getRatingBadge = (rating: string, size: 'sm' | 'lg' = 'sm') => {
    const config = RATING_CONFIG[rating] || RATING_CONFIG['U']
    const Icon = config.icon

    if (size === 'lg') {
      return (
        <div className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg ${config.bgColor} border-2 ${config.borderColor}`}>
          <Icon className={`h-5 w-5 ${config.color}`} />
          <div>
            <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${config.color}`}>{rating}</div>
            <div className={`text-xs ${config.color} opacity-75`}>{config.label}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }

    return (
      <Badge variant="outline" className={`${config.bgColor} ${config.borderColor} ${config.color} border-2`}>
        <Icon className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
        {rating}
      </Badge>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-full p-6 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
            <Droplet className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-serif font-bold flex items-center gap-3">
              Knowledge Twins
              <PageHelp content={helpContent.knowledgeTwins} />
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Evidence-based O2/H2 material compatibility using NASA Body of Knowledge
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-6">

        {/* Fluid Type Selector */}
        <Tabs value={activeFluid} onValueChange={(v) => setActiveFluid(v as 'oxygen' | 'hydrogen')}>
          <TabsList className="grid w-full max-w-md grid-cols-2">
            <TabsTrigger value="oxygen">
              <Droplet className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              Oxygen (O2)
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="hydrogen">
              <Flame className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              Hydrogen (H2)
            </TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
        </Tabs>

        {/* Mode Toggle */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 items-center">
          <Button
            variant={mode === 'browse' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setMode('browse')}
            size="sm"
          >
            Browse Materials
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={mode === 'ask' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setMode('ask')}
            size="sm"
          >
            Ask Question
          </Button>

          {/* LLM Provider Toggle (only in Ask mode) */}
          {mode === 'ask' && (
            <div className="ml-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">LLM:</span>
              <Button
                variant={llmProvider === 'ollama' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                onClick={() => setLlmProvider('ollama')}
                size="sm"
              >
                Local (Ollama)
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant={llmProvider === 'haiku' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                onClick={() => setLlmProvider('haiku')}
                size="sm"
              >
                Claude Haiku
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Search Bar */}
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="pt-6">
            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <Input
                placeholder={
                  mode === 'ask'
                    ? `Ask a question about ${activeFluid} compatibility (e.g., "Can I use aluminum in ${activeFluid} service?")`
                    : `Search ${activeFluid} compatibility (e.g., "materials compatible with ${activeFluid} at 20psi")`
                }
                value={query}
                onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && (mode === 'browse' ? handleSearch() : handleAsk())}
              />
              <Button
                onClick={mode === 'browse' ? handleSearch : handleAsk}
                disabled={loading || !query.trim()}
              >
                {loading ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                    {mode === 'ask' ? 'Thinking...' : 'Searching...'}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Search className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                    {mode === 'ask' ? 'Ask' : 'Search'}
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Error Message */}
        {error && (
          <Card className="border-2 border-red-500">
            <CardContent className="pt-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-red-600">
                <XCircle className="h-6 w-6" />
                <div>
                  <div className="font-bold">{mode === 'ask' ? 'Question Error' : 'Search Error'}</div>
                  <div className="text-sm">{error}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}

        {/* Ask Mode - Hybrid Query Results */}
        {mode === 'ask' && !loading && hybridResponse && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {/* Deterministic Decision Card - MOST IMPORTANT */}
            {hybridResponse.deterministic_decision && (
              <Card className={`border-2 ${
                hybridResponse.deterministic_decision === 'YES' ? 'border-green-500 bg-green-50' :
                hybridResponse.deterministic_decision === 'NO' ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50' :
                'border-yellow-500 bg-yellow-50'
              }`}>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {hybridResponse.deterministic_decision === 'YES' ? (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-green-600" />
                    ) : hybridResponse.deterministic_decision === 'NO' ? (
                      <XCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-red-600" />
                    ) : (
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-yellow-600" />
                    )}
                    Decision: {hybridResponse.deterministic_decision}
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-2">{hybridResponse.decision_source}</Badge>
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <p className="text-sm">{hybridResponse.decision_rationale}</p>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* LLM Explanation */}
            {(hybridResponse.answer || hybridResponse.explanation) && (
              <Card className="border-2 border-blue-500 bg-blue-50">
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
                    MIRA Analysis
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  <div className="prose prose-sm max-w-none whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono text-sm bg-white p-4 rounded border border-blue-200">
                    {hybridResponse.answer || hybridResponse.explanation}
                  </div>
                  {hybridResponse.constraints && (
                    <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-blue-200">
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold mb-2">Extracted Constraints:</p>
                      <pre className="text-xs bg-white p-3 rounded border border-blue-200 overflow-x-auto">
                        {JSON.stringify(hybridResponse.constraints, null, 2)}
                      </pre>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* Evidence Summary Card */}
            <Card className="border-2 border-blue-500">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <HelpCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
                  Evidence Summary
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
                      {hybridResponse.evidence_summary.mua_precedents_found}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">MUA Precedents</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
                      {hybridResponse.evidence_summary.test_results_found}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Test Results</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">
                      {hybridResponse.evidence_summary.requirements_evaluated}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Requirements</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">
                      {hybridResponse.evidence_summary.semantic_results_found}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Semantic Results</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-center">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-600">
                      {hybridResponse.evidence_summary.high_confidence_semantic}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">High Confidence</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {hybridResponse.insufficient_data && (
                  <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-yellow-800">
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold">Insufficient Data</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* Decisions */}
            {hybridResponse.decisions && hybridResponse.decisions.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="border-2 border-green-500">
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-green-600" />
                    Material Compatibility Decisions
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                  {hybridResponse.decisions.map((decision, idx) => (
                    <Card key={idx} className="border-l-4 border-l-green-500">
                      <CardContent className="pt-4">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                          <h4 className="font-bold text-lg">{decision.decision}</h4>
                          <Badge variant="outline">{decision.confidence}</Badge>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 mb-3">{decision.reasoning}</p>
                        {decision.citations && decision.citations.length > 0 && (
                          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            <span className="font-semibold">Citations: </span>
                            {decision.citations.join(', ')}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* Semantic Evidence */}
            {hybridResponse.semantic_evidence?.results && hybridResponse.semantic_evidence.results.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="border-2 border-orange-500">
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>Semantic Search Results</span>
                    <Badge variant="secondary">{hybridResponse.semantic_evidence.total_results}</Badge>
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                  {hybridResponse.semantic_evidence.results.slice(0, 10).map((result, idx) => (
                    <Card key={idx} className="border-l-4 border-l-orange-500">
                      <CardContent className="pt-4">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-xs">
                            {result.source}
                          </Badge>
                          <Badge variant="secondary">
                            {(result.score * 100).toFixed(0)}% match
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 leading-relaxed">{result.text}</p>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Browse Mode - Results */}
        {mode === 'browse' && !loading && (materials.length > 0 || bokResults.length > 0) && (
          <div className="space-y-8">

            {/* SECTION 1: RECOMMENDED MATERIALS */}
            {materials.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-1">
                    Recommended Materials
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Materials with {activeFluid} compatibility ratings from MAPTIS database
                  </p>
                </div>

                {sortedRatings.map((rating) => {
                  const config = RATING_CONFIG[rating]
                  const materialsInRating = groupedMaterials[rating]
                  const Icon = config.icon

                  return (
                    <Card key={rating} className={`border-2 ${config.borderColor}`}>
                      <CardHeader className={config.bgColor}>
                        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <Icon className={`h-5 w-5 ${config.color}`} />
                          <div>
                            <div className="text-lg font-bold">
                              {config.label} (Rating {rating})
                            </div>
                            <div className={`text-xs font-normal ${config.color} opacity-75`}>
                              {config.description} - {materialsInRating.length} {materialsInRating.length === 1 ? 'material' : 'materials'}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </CardTitle>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent className="pt-6">
                        <div className="grid gap-4">
                          {materialsInRating.map((material, idx) => (
                            <Card key={idx} className="border hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors">
                              <CardContent className="pt-6">
                                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                                  <div className="flex-1">
                                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold mb-2">
                                      {material.material_designation || material.material_name || material.material_key}
                                    </h3>

                                    {/* Rating Grid */}
                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-3">
                                      {material.flamm_rating && material.flamm_rating !== 'No data' && (
                                        <div>
                                          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">FLAMM</div>
                                          {getRatingBadge(material.flamm_rating)}
                                        </div>
                                      )}
                                      {material.corr_rating && material.corr_rating !== 'No data' && (
                                        <div>
                                          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">CORR</div>
                                          {getRatingBadge(material.corr_rating)}
                                        </div>
                                      )}
                                      {material.scc_rating && material.scc_rating !== 'No data' && (
                                        <div>
                                          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">SCC</div>
                                          {getRatingBadge(material.scc_rating)}
                                        </div>
                                      )}
                                      {material.tvs_rating && material.tvs_rating !== 'No data' && (
                                        <div>
                                          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">TVS</div>
                                          {getRatingBadge(material.tvs_rating)}
                                        </div>
                                      )}
                                    </div>

                                    {material.snippet && (
                                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">
                                        {material.snippet}
                                      </p>
                                    )}
                                  </div>

                                  <div className="flex-shrink-0">
                                    {getRatingBadge(rating, 'lg')}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </CardContent>
                            </Card>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* SECTION 2: STANDARDS GUIDANCE */}
            {bokResults.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-1">
                    Standards Guidance
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Supporting documentation from NASA {activeFluid.toUpperCase()} Body of Knowledge
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                  {bokResults.map((result, idx) => (
                    <Card key={idx} className="border hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors">
                      <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="flex items-start justify-between">
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <div className="text-base font-bold mb-1">
                              {result.source} {result.section && `${result.section}`}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                              {result.tags.join(' - ')}
                              {result.page && ` - Page ${result.page}`}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-4">
                            Score: {(result.relevance_score * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </Badge>
                        </CardTitle>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {result.text || 'No content available'}
                        </p>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

          </div>
        )}

        {/* Empty State */}
        {!loading && materials.length === 0 && bokResults.length === 0 && !hybridResponse && query && (
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="pt-8 pb-8 text-center">
              <Search className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto mb-3 text-muted-foreground opacity-50" />
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-1">No results found</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Try adjusting your search query or switching fluids
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { FlaskConical, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { PageHelp } from "@/components/PageHelp";
import helpContent from "@/config/helpContent";

interface TestClass {
  name: string;
  count: number;
  description: string;
}

const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000';

export default function TestClasses() {
  const [testClasses, setTestClasses] = useState<TestClass[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const toSlug = (name: string) =>
    name
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s\/-]/g, "")
      .replace(/[\s\/]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/-+/g, "-")
      .trim();

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTestClasses = async () => {
      try {
        // Fetch dynamic counts from API
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/test-classes/counts`);
        const counts = await response.json();

        // Define test class metadata (descriptions)
        const testClassMetadata: Record<string, { name: string; description: string }> = {
          'tvs-outgassing': { name: "TVS Outgassing", description: "Total Mass Loss, Collected Volatile Condensable Material" },
          'flammability': { name: "Flammability", description: "Upward and downward flame propagation ratings" },
          'mechanical-impact': { name: "Mechanical Impact", description: "Impact energy absorption and failure characteristics" },
          'toxicity': { name: "Toxicity", description: "Off-gassing toxicity measurements" },
          'stress-corrosion-cracking': { name: "Stress Corrosion Cracking", description: "Material susceptibility to stress corrosion" },
          'corrosion': { name: "Corrosion", description: "General corrosion resistance testing" },
          'fluid-compatibility': { name: "Fluid Compatibility", description: "Material compatibility with various fluids" },
          'odor': { name: "Odor", description: "Odor intensity ratings" },
          'flash-fire': { name: "Flash Fire", description: "Flash fire propagation characteristics" },
          'tensile-strength': { name: "Tensile Strength", description: "Tensile strength and elongation properties" },
          'pneumatic-impact': { name: "Pneumatic Impact", description: "Pneumatic impact resistance testing" },
          'promoted-combustion': { name: "Promoted Combustion", description: "Combustion promotion characteristics" },
          'particle-impact': { name: "Particle Impact", description: "Particle impact resistance" },
          'electrical-overload': { name: "Electrical Overload", description: "Electrical overload characteristics" },
          'vcm-optical': { name: "VCM Optical", description: "Volatile condensable material and optical properties" },
          'electric-wire-insulation': { name: "Electric Wire Insulation", description: "Wire insulation electrical properties" },
          'low-cycle-fatigue': { name: "Low Cycle Fatigue", description: "Low cycle fatigue resistance" },
          'fungus': { name: "Fungus", description: "Fungal resistance testing" },
          'fracture-mechanics': { name: "Fracture Mechanics", description: "Fracture toughness characteristics" },
          'creep-rupture': { name: "Creep Rupture", description: "Creep and rupture behavior" },
          'high-cycle-fatigue': { name: "High Cycle Fatigue", description: "High cycle fatigue resistance" },
          'friction-heat': { name: "Friction Heat", description: "Friction and heat generation characteristics" },
          'crack-growth': { name: "Crack Growth", description: "Crack propagation rates" },
          'arc-tracking': { name: "Arc Tracking", description: "Electrical arc tracking resistance" },
        };

        // Build test classes array from API counts
        const testClassesArray: TestClass[] = Object.entries(counts).map(([slug, count]) => ({
          name: testClassMetadata[slug]?.name || slug,
          count: count as number,
          description: testClassMetadata[slug]?.description || 'Test data',
        }));

        // Sort alphabetically by name
        const sortedTestClasses = testClassesArray.sort((a, b) =>
          a.name.localeCompare(b.name)
        );

        setTestClasses(sortedTestClasses);
        setIsLoading(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch test class counts:', error);
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchTestClasses();
  }, []);

  const totalTests = testClasses.reduce((sum, tc) => sum + tc.count, 0);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-full p-6 space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-serif font-bold mb-1 flex items-center gap-3">
          Test Classes Browser
          <PageHelp content={helpContent.testClasses} />
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {isLoading ? 'Loading...' : `${testClasses.length} test types | ${totalTests.toLocaleString()} total test records`}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Test classes grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {testClasses.map((testClass) => (
          <Card
            key={testClass.name}
            className="p-4 hover:border-primary transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
            onClick={() => navigate(`/test-classes/${toSlug(testClass.name)}`)}
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2 bg-primary/10 rounded-lg">
                  <FlaskConical className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-medium group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                    {testClass.name}
                  </h3>
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="mt-1">
                    {testClass.count.toLocaleString()} records
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              </div>
              <ChevronRight className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {testClass.description}
            </p>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Coming soon */}
      <Card className="p-6 bg-muted/50">
        <h3 className="font-medium mb-2">Coming Soon</h3>
        <ul className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
          <li>- Unit-aware filters (pressure, temperature, concentration)</li>
          <li>- Statistical summaries and distributions</li>
          <li>- Interactive plot builders</li>
          <li>- Export test datasets to CSV/JSON</li>
        </ul>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
