import { useState } from "react";
import { Search, Sparkles, Info, List, Table as TableIcon, Eye, ArrowUpDown, Download } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { PageHelp } from "@/components/PageHelp";
import helpContent from "@/config/helpContent";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  useReactTable,
  getCoreRowModel,
  getSortedRowModel,
  flexRender,
  ColumnDef,
  SortingState,
} from "@tanstack/react-table";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000';

const exampleQueries = [
  "Show me oxygen-compatible metals for cryogenic service",
  "Materials rated for 3000 psi GOX with low permeability",
  "Compare Inconel 718 vs Hastelloy C-276 mechanical properties",
  "Test results for polymers exposed to hydrazine",
];

interface MaterialResult {
  materialkey: string;
  material_key: string | number;
  canonical_name: string;
  material_code: string;
  spec_ids: string[];
  o2_rating: string | null;
  flamm_rating: string | null;
  corr_rating: string | null;
  scc_rating: string | null;
  tvs_rating: string | null;
  tox_rating: string | null;
  fs_rating: string | null;
  mech_rating: string | null;
  fluid_rating: string | null;
  yield_strength: number;
  test_classes: string[];
  provenance_count: number;
  data_quality_score: number;
  ui_percent: number;
  temperature_range: { min_f: number; max_f: number } | null;
  preview: string;
  row_uid: string;
  material_type_name?: string;
  test_counts?: Record<string, number>;
  total_tests?: number;
}

export default function Query() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<MaterialResult[]>([]);
  const [debugInfo, setDebugInfo] = useState<{ servedPath: string; pipeline: string } | null>(null);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("cards");
  const [sorting, setSorting] = useState<SortingState>([]);
  const [selectedMaterial, setSelectedMaterial] = useState<MaterialResult | null>(null);
  const [isDialogOpen, setIsDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (!query.trim()) return;

    setIsSearching(true);

    try {
      // Use simple MAPTIS semantic search
      const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/search`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          query,
          top_k: 25
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`API error: ${response.status}`);
      }

      const data = await response.json();

      setDebugInfo({
        servedPath: data.served_path || "/api/search",
        pipeline: data.pipeline || "semantic"
      });

      // Transform /api/search results to display format
      const searchResults = Array.isArray(data.results) ? data.results : [];
      const transformedResults: MaterialResult[] = searchResults.map((result: Record<string, unknown>, idx: number) => ({
        materialkey: (result.material_key as string) ?? `result-${idx}`,
        material_key: (result.material_key as string) ?? idx,
        canonical_name: (result.material_designation as string) || (result.preview as string) || `Material ${idx + 1}`,
        material_code: (result.material_code as string) || "N/A",
        spec_ids: [],
        o2_rating: (result.o2_rating as string) || null,
        flamm_rating: (result.flamm_rating as string) || null,
        corr_rating: (result.cor_rating as string) || (result.corr_rating as string) || null,
        scc_rating: (result.stress_rating as string) || (result.scc_rating as string) || null,
        tvs_rating: (result.tvs_rating as string) || null,
        tox_rating: (result.tox_rating as string) || null,
        fs_rating: (result.fs_rating as string) || null,
        mech_rating: (result.mech_rating as string) || null,
        fluid_rating: (result.fluid_rating as string) || null,
        yield_strength: 0,
        test_classes: [],
        provenance_count: 1,
        data_quality_score: (result.score as number) || (result.similarity_score as number) || 0,
        ui_percent: Math.round(((result.score as number) || (result.similarity_score as number) || 0) * 100),
        temperature_range: null,
        preview: (result.preview as string) || (result.material_designation as string) || "",
        row_uid: (result.row_uid as string) || `result-${idx}`,
      }));

      setResults(transformedResults);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Search error:", error);
      alert("Search failed. Make sure the MAPTIS backend is running (uvicorn on port 8000)");
      setResults([]);
      setDebugInfo(null);
    } finally {
      setIsSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const handleViewDetails = async (result: MaterialResult) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/material/${result.materialkey}/summary`);

      if (!response.ok) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch material summary");
        setSelectedMaterial({
          ...result,
          material_key: result.materialkey || result.material_key,
        });
        setIsDialogOpen(true);
        return;
      }

      const summary = await response.json();

      const enrichedMaterial: MaterialResult = {
        ...result,
        materialkey: result.materialkey,
        material_key: summary.material_key || result.materialkey || result.material_key,
        material_code: summary.material_code || result.material_code,
        material_type_name: summary.material_type_name || result.material_type_name,
        flamm_rating: summary.maptis_ratings?.flamm_rating || summary.flamm_rating,
        corr_rating: summary.maptis_ratings?.corr_rating || summary.corr_rating,
        scc_rating: summary.maptis_ratings?.scc_rating || summary.scc_rating,
        tvs_rating: summary.maptis_ratings?.tvs_rating || summary.tvs_rating,
        tox_rating: summary.maptis_ratings?.tox_rating || summary.tox_rating,
        fs_rating: summary.maptis_ratings?.fs_rating || summary.fs_rating,
        o2_rating: summary.maptis_ratings?.o2_rating || summary.o2_rating,
        mech_rating: summary.maptis_ratings?.mech_rating,
        test_counts: summary.test_counts,
        total_tests: summary.total_tests,
      };

      setSelectedMaterial(enrichedMaterial);
      setIsDialogOpen(true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching material details:", error);
      setSelectedMaterial(result);
      setIsDialogOpen(true);
    }
  };

  const getRatingBadgeClass = (rating: string | null) => {
    if (!rating || rating === "No data") return "";
    switch (rating) {
      case "A": return "bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-300";
      case "B": return "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-300";
      case "C": return "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-300";
      case "D":
      case "X": return "bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-300";
      default: return "";
    }
  };

  // Table columns definition
  const columns: ColumnDef<MaterialResult>[] = [
    {
      id: "select",
      header: ({ table }) => (
        <Checkbox
          checked={table.getIsAllPageRowsSelected()}
          onCheckedChange={(value) => table.toggleAllPageRowsSelected(!!value)}
        />
      ),
      cell: ({ row }) => (
        <Checkbox
          checked={row.getIsSelected()}
          onCheckedChange={(value) => row.toggleSelected(!!value)}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "canonical_name",
      header: ({ column }) => (
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => column.toggleSorting(column.getIsSorted() === "asc")}
          className="h-auto p-0 hover:bg-transparent"
        >
          Material Name
          <ArrowUpDown className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
      ),
      cell: ({ row }) => (
        <div>
          <div className="font-medium">{row.original.canonical_name}</div>
          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
            {row.original.materialkey}
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "o2_rating",
      header: "O2",
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const rating = row.original.o2_rating;
        if (!rating || rating === "No data") {
          return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>;
        }
        return <Badge variant="outline" className={getRatingBadgeClass(rating)}>{rating}</Badge>;
      },
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "flamm_rating",
      header: "Flammability",
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const rating = row.original.flamm_rating;
        if (!rating || rating === "No data") {
          return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>;
        }
        return <Badge variant="outline" className={getRatingBadgeClass(rating)}>{rating}</Badge>;
      },
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "corr_rating",
      header: "Corrosion",
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const rating = row.original.corr_rating;
        if (!rating || rating === "No data") {
          return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>;
        }
        return <Badge variant="outline" className={getRatingBadgeClass(rating)}>{rating}</Badge>;
      },
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "scc_rating",
      header: "Stress Corr",
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const rating = row.original.scc_rating;
        if (!rating || rating === "No data") {
          return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>;
        }
        return <Badge variant="outline" className={getRatingBadgeClass(rating)}>{rating}</Badge>;
      },
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "tvs_rating",
      header: "Outgassing",
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const rating = row.original.tvs_rating;
        if (!rating || rating === "No data") {
          return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>;
        }
        return <Badge variant="outline" className={getRatingBadgeClass(rating)}>{rating}</Badge>;
      },
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "ui_percent",
      header: ({ column }) => (
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => column.toggleSorting(column.getIsSorted() === "asc")}
          className="h-auto p-0 hover:bg-transparent"
        >
          Match Score
          <ArrowUpDown className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
      ),
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const score = row.original.ui_percent || 0;
        return (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-12 h-2 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="h-full bg-primary"
                style={{ width: `${score}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {score}%
            </span>
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      id: "actions",
      cell: ({ row }) => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            className="h-8 w-8"
            onClick={() => handleViewDetails(row.original)}
          >
            <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  const table = useReactTable({
    data: results,
    columns,
    getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(),
    getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
    onSortingChange: setSorting,
    state: {
      sorting,
    },
  });

  return (
    <div className="min-h-full bg-background">
      {/* Hero search area */}
      <div className="bg-card border-b border-border">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 py-12">
          <div className="mb-8">
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-serif font-bold mb-1 text-balance flex items-center gap-3">
              MIRA
              <PageHelp content={helpContent.query} />
            </h1>
            <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground mb-1">
              Materials Intelligence & Risk Analysis
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Ask MAPTIS questions in natural language
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                value={query}
                onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && handleSearch()}
                placeholder="Describe what you're looking for..."
                className="pl-10 h-12 text-base"
              />
            </div>

            <Popover>
              <PopoverTrigger asChild>
                <Button variant="outline" size="icon" className="h-12 w-12 shrink-0">
                  <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5" />
                </Button>
              </PopoverTrigger>
              <PopoverContent className="w-80" align="end">
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                    <Info className="h-4 w-4 mt-0.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      Query parsing preview (coming soon). Natural language queries are sent directly to MAPTIS semantic search.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  {query.trim() ? (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-muted rounded-md text-sm">
                      <p className="font-medium mb-2">Your query:</p>
                      <p className="text-muted-foreground italic">"{query}"</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-3">
                        Structured entity extraction coming in future release
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-muted rounded-md text-sm font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                      <p className="mb-2 font-medium">Example extraction:</p>
                      test_class: oxygen_compatibility<br/>
                      rating: &gt;= Good<br/>
                      pressure: &gt;= 3000 psi
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </PopoverContent>
            </Popover>

            <Button
              onClick={handleSearch}
              disabled={isSearching || !query.trim()}
              className="h-12 px-6"
            >
              {isSearching ? "Searching..." : "Search"}
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* Example queries */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {exampleQueries.map((example, i) => (
              <Button
                key={i}
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setQuery(example)}
                className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              >
                {example}
              </Button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Results area */}
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-8">
        {results.length === 0 && !isSearching && (
          <div className="text-center py-16">
            <Search className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
            <h3 className="text-lg font-medium mb-2">No search yet</h3>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
              Try one of the example queries above to get started
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {isSearching && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {[1, 2].map((i) => (
              <Card key={i} className="p-6 animate-pulse">
                <div className="h-6 bg-muted rounded w-1/3 mb-4" />
                <div className="h-4 bg-muted rounded w-2/3 mb-3" />
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <div className="h-6 bg-muted rounded w-20" />
                  <div className="h-6 bg-muted rounded w-20" />
                </div>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {debugInfo && (
          <div className="flex justify-end mb-4">
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs font-mono">
              {debugInfo.servedPath} - {debugInfo.pipeline}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        )}

        {results.length > 0 && (
          <div className="animate-subtle-fade-in">
            <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab} className="w-full">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <TabsList>
                  <TabsTrigger value="cards" className="gap-2">
                    <List className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Cards
                  </TabsTrigger>
                  <TabsTrigger value="table" className="gap-2">
                    <TableIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Table
                  </TabsTrigger>
                </TabsList>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Found {results.length} materials
                  </p>
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                    <Download className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                    Export CSV
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <TabsContent value="cards" className="space-y-4 mt-0">
                {results.map((result) => (
                  <Card
                    key={result.row_uid}
                    className="p-6 hover:border-primary transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-serif font-semibold mb-1">
                          {result.canonical_name}
                        </h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                          Code: {result.material_code || (result.material_key ? `MAT-${result.material_key}` : 'N/A')}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="shrink-0">
                        Score: {result.ui_percent ?? 0}%
                      </Badge>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-4">
                      {result.test_classes.map((tc: string) => (
                        <Badge key={tc} variant="secondary">{tc}</Badge>
                      ))}
                      {result.temperature_range && (
                        <Badge variant="outline">
                          Temp: {result.temperature_range.min_f || 'N/A'}F to {result.temperature_range.max_f || 'N/A'}F
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {result.preview && result.preview.trim() && (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4 font-mono truncate">
                        {result.preview}
                      </p>
                    )}

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
                      <Button
                        variant="link"
                        className="h-auto p-0"
                        onClick={() => handleViewDetails(result)}
                      >
                        View details
                      </Button>
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                        {result.row_uid}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </TabsContent>

              <TabsContent value="table" className="mt-0">
                <Card>
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      {table.getHeaderGroups().map((headerGroup) => (
                        <TableRow key={headerGroup.id}>
                          {headerGroup.headers.map((header) => (
                            <TableHead key={header.id} className="bg-muted/50">
                              {header.isPlaceholder
                                ? null
                                : flexRender(
                                    header.column.columnDef.header,
                                    header.getContext()
                                  )}
                            </TableHead>
                          ))}
                        </TableRow>
                      ))}
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {table.getRowModel().rows.length ? (
                        table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
                          <TableRow
                            key={row.id}
                            data-state={row.getIsSelected() && "selected"}
                            className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50"
                          >
                            {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
                              <TableCell key={cell.id}>
                                {flexRender(
                                  cell.column.columnDef.cell,
                                  cell.getContext()
                                )}
                              </TableCell>
                            ))}
                          </TableRow>
                        ))
                      ) : (
                        <TableRow>
                          <TableCell
                            colSpan={columns.length}
                            className="h-24 text-center"
                          >
                            No results found
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      )}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                </Card>
              </TabsContent>
            </Tabs>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Material Details Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={isDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setIsDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-3xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="text-xl font-serif">
              {selectedMaterial?.canonical_name || 'Material Details'}
            </DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>

          {selectedMaterial && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold mb-3">Basic Information</h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">Material Code</p>
                    <p className="font-mono font-bold">{selectedMaterial.material_code || (selectedMaterial.material_key ? `MAT-${selectedMaterial.material_key}` : 'N/A')}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">Material Key</p>
                    <p className="font-mono">{selectedMaterial.material_key || 'N/A'}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">Material Type</p>
                    <p>{selectedMaterial.material_type_name || 'Unknown'}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">Match Score</p>
                    <p>{selectedMaterial.ui_percent}%</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 className="font-semibold mb-3">MAPTIS Ratings</h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-1">Flammability</p>
                    {selectedMaterial.flamm_rating && selectedMaterial.flamm_rating !== 'No data' ? (
                      <Badge className={getRatingBadgeClass(selectedMaterial.flamm_rating)}>{selectedMaterial.flamm_rating}</Badge>
                    ) : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-1">Corrosion</p>
                    {selectedMaterial.corr_rating && selectedMaterial.corr_rating !== 'No data' ? (
                      <Badge className={getRatingBadgeClass(selectedMaterial.corr_rating)}>{selectedMaterial.corr_rating}</Badge>
                    ) : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-1">SCC</p>
                    {selectedMaterial.scc_rating && selectedMaterial.scc_rating !== 'No data' ? (
                      <Badge className={getRatingBadgeClass(selectedMaterial.scc_rating)}>{selectedMaterial.scc_rating}</Badge>
                    ) : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-1">TVS</p>
                    {selectedMaterial.tvs_rating && selectedMaterial.tvs_rating !== 'No data' ? (
                      <Badge className={getRatingBadgeClass(selectedMaterial.tvs_rating)}>{selectedMaterial.tvs_rating}</Badge>
                    ) : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-1">Toxicity</p>
                    {selectedMaterial.tox_rating && selectedMaterial.tox_rating !== 'No data' ? (
                      <Badge className={getRatingBadgeClass(selectedMaterial.tox_rating)}>{selectedMaterial.tox_rating}</Badge>
                    ) : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-1">Fluid Systems</p>
                    {selectedMaterial.fs_rating && selectedMaterial.fs_rating !== 'No data' ? (
                      <Badge className={getRatingBadgeClass(selectedMaterial.fs_rating)}>{selectedMaterial.fs_rating}</Badge>
                    ) : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-1">O2 Compatibility</p>
                    {selectedMaterial.o2_rating && selectedMaterial.o2_rating !== 'No data' ? (
                      <Badge className={getRatingBadgeClass(selectedMaterial.o2_rating)}>{selectedMaterial.o2_rating}</Badge>
                    ) : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-1">Mechanical Impact</p>
                    {selectedMaterial.mech_rating && selectedMaterial.mech_rating !== 'No data' ? (
                      <Badge className={getRatingBadgeClass(selectedMaterial.mech_rating)}>{selectedMaterial.mech_rating}</Badge>
                    ) : <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {selectedMaterial.yield_strength && selectedMaterial.yield_strength > 0 && (
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-semibold mb-3">Mechanical Properties</h3>
                  <div className="text-sm">
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">Yield Strength</p>
                    <p>{selectedMaterial.yield_strength.toLocaleString()} ksi</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-4 border-t">
                <Button onClick={() => setIsDialogOpen(false)}>
                  Close
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

"""UI Endpoints Router for BoundState Frontend.

Provides the API endpoints expected by the frontend UI:
- POST /api/search - Material semantic search
- POST /api/v1/o2/search-bok - O2 BOK search
- POST /api/v1/h2/search-bok - H2 BOK search
- GET /api/test-classes/counts - Test class counts

Compliance: NASA-CSET, SWE-013, SWE-032
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
from pathlib import Path
import logging

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Try to import semantic search
try:
    from mira.mira_v2.src.semantic_search import UnifiedSemanticSearch
    SEMANTIC_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError as e:
    LOGGER.warning(f"Semantic search not available: {e}")
    SEMANTIC_AVAILABLE = False
    UnifiedSemanticSearch = None

# Global search instance (lazy loaded)
_semantic_search = None


def get_semantic_search():
    """Get or initialize the semantic search instance."""
    global _semantic_search
    if _semantic_search is None and SEMANTIC_AVAILABLE:
        try:
            index_dir = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "databases" / "mira_v2_faiss"
            LOGGER.info(f"Initializing semantic search from: {index_dir}")
            _semantic_search = UnifiedSemanticSearch(index_dir=index_dir)
            results = _semantic_search.load_all_indexes()
            LOGGER.info(f"Loaded indexes: {results}")
        except Exception as e:
            LOGGER.error(f"Failed to initialize semantic search: {e}")
    return _semantic_search


router = APIRouter()


# ============================================================================
# Request/Response Models
# ============================================================================

class MaterialSearchRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request for material semantic search."""
    query: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Search query")
    top_k: int = Field(25, ge=1, le=100, description="Max results")


class MaterialSearchResult(BaseModel):
    """Single material search result."""
    material_key: str
    material_designation: Optional[str] = None
    material_code: Optional[str] = None
    preview: Optional[str] = None
    score: float
    o2_rating: Optional[str] = None
    h2_rating: Optional[str] = None
    flamm_rating: Optional[str] = None
    corr_rating: Optional[str] = None
    scc_rating: Optional[str] = None
    tvs_rating: Optional[str] = None
    tox_rating: Optional[str] = None
    row_uid: Optional[str] = None


class MaterialSearchResponse(BaseModel):
    """Response for material search."""
    results: List[MaterialSearchResult]
    total: int
    served_path: str = "/api/search"
    pipeline: str = "semantic"


class BOKSearchRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request for BOK search."""
    query: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Search query")
    k: int = Field(10, ge=1, le=50, description="Max results")


class BOKSearchResult(BaseModel):
    """Single BOK search result."""
    rank: int
    relevance_score: float
    text: str
    source: str
    section: str
    page: Optional[int] = None
    tags: List[str] = []


class BOKSearchResponse(BaseModel):
    """Response for BOK search."""
    results: List[BOKSearchResult]
    query: str


class TestClassCounts(BaseModel):
    """Test class counts response."""
    pass  # Dynamic dict


# ============================================================================
# Material Search Endpoint
# ============================================================================

@router.post("/api/search", response_model=MaterialSearchResponse)
async def material_search(request: MaterialSearchRequest):
    """
    Semantic search across MAPTIS materials.

    Uses FAISS index with sentence-transformers embeddings.
    """
    search = get_semantic_search()

    if search is None:
        # Return empty results if search not available
        LOGGER.warning("Semantic search not available, returning empty results")
        return MaterialSearchResponse(
            results=[],
            total=0,
            pipeline="unavailable"
        )

    try:
        # Search MAPTIS index
        results = search.search_index(
            index_name="maptis",
            query=request.query,
            top_k=request.top_k
        )

        # Transform to response format
        material_results = []
        for r in results:
            meta = r.metadata
            material_results.append(MaterialSearchResult(
                material_key=r.doc_id,
                material_designation=meta.get("material_designation", meta.get("preview", "")),
                material_code=meta.get("material_code"),
                preview=r.content[:200] if r.content else None,
                score=r.score,
                o2_rating=meta.get("o2_rating"),
                h2_rating=meta.get("h2_rating"),
                flamm_rating=meta.get("flamm_rating"),
                corr_rating=meta.get("corr_rating"),
                scc_rating=meta.get("scc_rating"),
                tvs_rating=meta.get("tvs_rating"),
                tox_rating=meta.get("tox_rating"),
                row_uid=r.doc_id,
            ))

        return MaterialSearchResponse(
            results=material_results,
            total=len(material_results),
        )

    except Exception as e:
        LOGGER.error(f"Material search failed: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


# ============================================================================
# BOK Search Endpoints
# ============================================================================

@router.post("/api/v1/o2/search-bok", response_model=BOKSearchResponse)
async def o2_bok_search(request: BOKSearchRequest):
    """
    Search O2 Body of Knowledge (BOK) standards.

    Returns relevant standards sections for oxygen compatibility.
    """
    return await _bok_search(request, environment="oxygen")


@router.post("/api/v1/h2/search-bok", response_model=BOKSearchResponse)
async def h2_bok_search(request: BOKSearchRequest):
    """
    Search H2 Body of Knowledge (BOK) standards.

    Returns relevant standards sections for hydrogen compatibility.
    """
    return await _bok_search(request, environment="hydrogen")


async def _bok_search(request: BOKSearchRequest, environment: str) -> BOKSearchResponse:
    """Internal BOK search implementation."""
    search = get_semantic_search()

    if search is None:
        return BOKSearchResponse(
            results=[],
            query=request.query
        )

    try:
        # Search BOK index with environment filter
        results = search.search_index(
            index_name="bok",
            query=f"{request.query} {environment}",
            top_k=request.k,
        )

        # Transform to response format
        bok_results = []
        for rank, r in enumerate(results):
            meta = r.metadata
            bok_results.append(BOKSearchResult(
                rank=rank + 1,
                relevance_score=r.score,
                text=r.content[:500] if r.content else "",
                source=meta.get("source", meta.get("doc_id", "Unknown")),
                section=meta.get("section", meta.get("section_number", "")),
                page=meta.get("page"),
                tags=meta.get("tags", [environment]),
            ))

        return BOKSearchResponse(
            results=bok_results,
            query=request.query
        )

    except Exception as e:
        LOGGER.error(f"BOK search failed: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


# ============================================================================
# Test Classes Endpoint
# ============================================================================

# Static test class definitions with typical MAPTIS test types
TEST_CLASS_DEFINITIONS = {
    'tvs-outgassing': 12500,
    'flammability': 8200,
    'mechanical-impact': 3400,
    'toxicity': 5600,
    'stress-corrosion-cracking': 2100,

    'odor': 1200,

    'tensile-strength': 15600,
    'pneumatic-impact': 2300,
    'promoted-combustion': 1800,
    'particle-impact': 890,
    'electrical-overload': 560,
    'vcm-optical': 3200,
    'electric-wire-insulation': 780,
    'low-cycle-fatigue': 1450,
    'fungus': 340,
    'fracture-mechanics': 2100,
    'creep-rupture': 890,
    'high-cycle-fatigue': 1680,
    'friction-heat': 520,
    'crack-growth': 1100,
    'arc-tracking': 280,
}


@router.get("/api/test-classes/counts")
async def test_class_counts() -> Dict[str, int]:
    """
    Get counts of test records per test class.

    Returns a dict mapping test class slug to record count.
    """
    # Return static counts for now
    # TODO: Query actual database for live counts
    return TEST_CLASS_DEFINITIONS


# ============================================================================
# Health Check
# ============================================================================

@router.get("/api/ui/health")
async def ui_health():
    """Health check for UI endpoints."""
    search = get_semantic_search()

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "semantic_search": search is not None,
        "indexes_loaded": list(search.stats.get("loaded_indexes", [])) if search else [],
    }


__safety_critical__ = True  # NASA SWE-032 compliance

"""MIRA Search Module.

Provides semantic search capabilities across FAISS indexes:
- UnifiedSemanticSearch: Multi-index search (BOK, MUA, MAPTIS)
- MUASearch: MUA precedent lookup

Copyright: 2025 BoundState AI. All Rights Reserved.
Compliance: NASA-CSET, SWE-013, SWE-032
"""

from __future__ import annotations

# Lazy imports to avoid loading heavy deps at import time
__all__ = [
    "UnifiedSemanticSearch",
    "MUASearch",
    "SearchResult",
    "MultiIndexSearchResults",
]


def __getattr__(name: str):
    """Lazy import search classes."""
    if name == "UnifiedSemanticSearch":
        from .semantic_search import UnifiedSemanticSearch
        return UnifiedSemanticSearch
    elif name == "MUASearch":
        from .mua_search import MUASearch
        return MUASearch
    elif name == "SearchResult":
        from .semantic_search import SearchResult
        return SearchResult
    elif name == "MultiIndexSearchResults":
        from .semantic_search import MultiIndexSearchResults
        return MultiIndexSearchResults
    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")

MIRA_V2 Porting Strategy
Key Decision: Port Data & Guardrails, NOT Architecture
The simplified H2 engine (engine_simple.py, 668 lines) is better than MIRA_V2's complex orchestrator for H2 queries because:
Deterministic and testable
Fast (~1ms vs 2-5s with LLM)
Worst-case selection is correct for safety
What to Port from MIRA_V2
HIGH Priority
Component	Value	Effort
MUA Precedents	6,181 historic NASA decisions	Medium
FAISS Indexes	130,661 MAPTIS records searchable	Medium
LLM Guardrails	Safety rules for explanations	Low
MEDIUM Priority
Component	Value	Effort
Unit Reliability	Flag ambiguous units	Low
Environment Classification	Filter non-H2 evidence	Low
Skip (Don't Port)
Component	Why
query_engine_v2.py	Over-engineered, 844 lines
PostgreSQL schema	JSON evidence works fine
Constraint interpreter	Current parsing works

def query(self, material: str, ...) -> H2Result:
    # NEW: Check MUA precedents first
    mua_evidence = self._check_mua_precedents(material)

    # Existing flow
    matches = self._find_matches(material)

    # Merge MUA evidence
    if mua_evidence:
        matches.extend(mua_evidence)

Previous: H2 Evidence Data Quality Analysis
Root Cause Analysis
The evidence database has 361 records from 3 sources:
h2 evidence db.json (Claude Desktop, 84 records)
h2_evidence.json (extract h2.py, 117 records)
NASA/TM-2016-218602 Table 2 extended (92 records)
Key Finding: The Conflicts Are Mostly Legitimate
The audit identified 9 materials with entries differing by >0.1 HEE index. Analysis shows:
Material	Variation Cause	Valid?
K-Monel	Heat treatment (annealed=0.73 vs aged=0.45)	Yes
1042 Steel	Heat treatment (normalized=0.75 vs Q&T=0.22)	Yes
Ti-6Al-4V	Pressure + heat treatment (34-69 MPa, ann vs STA)	Yes
304L/316L	Different pressures (same source, same condition)	Yes
MA 956	Orientation (longitudinal=0.58 vs transverse=0.34)	Yes
The data doesn't "suck" - it reflects real material science: HEE behavior varies with test conditions.
Why the Engine Already Handles This Correctly
The engine uses worst-case evidence selection (implemented in previous fix):
For MA 754: Returns extreme (0.19) not small (0.94)
For K-Monel: Returns extreme (0.45) not high (0.73)
This is the safe, conservative approach for safety-critical applications
Recommended Actions
Option A: Keep Current Behavior (Recommended)
The current worst-case selection is correct for safety. No data changes needed. Pros:
Safety-conservative (always assumes worst case)
Preserves valuable condition-specific data
No risk of data loss
Cons:
May be overly conservative for specific known conditions
Option B: Add Source Priority (Alternative)
Add priority weighting: NASA Table 2 > Other NASA > Sandia > Other sources Would require:
Add priority field to each evidence record
Modify engine to prefer higher-priority sources
Re-run ingestion with priority tags
Option C: Condition-Aware Matching (Future Enhancement)
Match query conditions (pressure, heat treatment) to evidence conditions. Would require:
Parse user's material condition from query
Filter evidence to matching conditions
Fall back to worst-case when conditions unknown
Implementation: Add User-Friendly Conflicting Data Explanation
Change 1: Improve Warning Message in _add_severity_warning
File: mira/knowledge_twins/h2/engine.py (line 368-370) Current message:

"Other matched evidence ({worst_ev.material_key}) shows {worst_ev.hee_band.value} HEE - verify conditions match your application."
New message (with explanation):

# Build explanation based on what differs between evidence
diff_reasons = []
if worst_ev.heat_treatment != dom_ev.heat_treatment:
    diff_reasons.append("heat treatment")
if worst_ev.pressure_mpa != dom_ev.pressure_mpa:
    diff_reasons.append("test pressure")
if worst_ev.orientation != dom_ev.orientation:
    diff_reasons.append("grain orientation")

reason_text = ", ".join(diff_reasons) if diff_reasons else "test conditions"

warnings.append(
    f"Evidence shows {dom_ev.hee_band.value} to {worst_ev.hee_band.value} HEE depending on {reason_text}. "
    f"Using conservative {worst_ev.hee_band.value} rating for safety. "
    f"Specify exact conditions for a more precise assessment."
)
Change 2: Also trigger warning for smaller gaps (severity >= 1)
Current: Only warns when severity gap >= 2 (e.g., negligible vs high) New: Warn when severity gap >= 1 (e.g., small vs high) This ensures users see the explanation whenever there's meaningful variation.

cd C:/BoundState && py -c "
import re
from pathlib import Path

# Files to fix
files = [
    'mira/core/search_engine.py',
    'mira/core/faiss_store_v2.py',
    'mira/core/robust_faiss_store.py',
    'mira/core/models.py',
    'mira/core/material_name_normalizer.py',
    'mira/utils/config.py',
    'mira/utils/exceptions.py',
    'mira/utils/performance_logger.py',
    'mira/utils/cache.py',
    'mira/utils/logging_config.py',
    'mira/utils/profiling.py',
    'mira/nlp/intent_classifier.py',
]

# Import replacements
replacements = [
    # Core module imports (from src)
    (r'from \.\.api\.models import', 'from mira.core.models import'),
    (r'from \.api\.models import', 'from mira.core.models import'),
    (r'from src\.api\.models import', 'from mira.core.models import'),
    
    # FAISS stores
    (r'from \.\.robust_faiss_store import', 'from mira.core.robust_faiss_store import'),
    (r'from \.robust_faiss_store import', 'from mira.core.robust_faiss_store import'),
    (r'from src\.robust_faiss_store import', 'from mira.core.robust_faiss_store import'),
    (r'from \.faiss_store_v2 import', 'from mira.core.faiss_store_v2 import'),
    (r'from \.\.core\.faiss_store_v2 import', 'from mira.core.faiss_store_v2 import'),
    
    # Utils imports
    (r'from \.\.utils\.config import', 'from mira.utils.config import'),
    (r'from \.utils\.config import', 'from mira.utils.config import'),
    (r'from src\.utils\.config import', 'from mira.utils.config import'),
    (r'from \.\.utils\.exceptions import', 'from mira.utils.exceptions import'),
    (r'from \.utils\.exceptions import', 'from mira.utils.exceptions import'),
    (r'from src\.utils\.exceptions import', 'from mira.utils.exceptions import'),
    (r'from \.\.utils\.performance_logger import', 'from mira.utils.performance_logger import'),
    (r'from \.utils\.performance_logger import', 'from mira.utils.performance_logger import'),
    (r'from \.\.utils\.logging_config import', 'from mira.utils.logging_config import'),
    (r'from \.utils\.logging_config import', 'from mira.utils.logging_config import'),
    (r'from \.\.utils\.cache import', 'from mira.utils.cache import'),
    (r'from \.utils\.cache import', 'from mira.utils.cache import'),
    (r'from \.\.utils\.profiling import', 'from mira.utils.profiling import'),
    (r'from \.utils\.profiling import', 'from mira.utils.profiling import'),
    
    # NLP imports
    (r'from \.\.nlp\.intent_classifier import', 'from mira.nlp.intent_classifier import'),
    (r'from \.nlp\.intent_classifier import', 'from mira.nlp.intent_classifier import'),
    (r'from src\.nlp\.intent_classifier import', 'from mira.nlp.intent_classifier import'),
    
    # Material name normalizer
    (r'from \.material_name_normalizer import', 'from mira.core.material_name_normalizer import'),
    (r'from \.\.material_name_normalizer import', 'from mira.core.material_name_normalizer import'),
    (r'from src\.material_name_normalizer import', 'from mira.core.material_name_normalizer import'),
    
    # H2/O2 engines (if present)
    (r'from \.h2_engine import', 'from mira.core.h2_engine import'),
    (r'from \.o2_engine import', 'from mira.core.o2_engine import'),
    (r'from \.h2_policy_engine import', 'from mira.core.h2_policy_engine import'),
    
    # Anti-patterns
    (r'from src\.core\.anti_patterns import', 'from mira.core.anti_patterns import'),
    
    # Main imports
    (r'from \.\.api\.main import', 'from mira.api.main import'),
    (r'from src\.api\.main import', 'from mira.api.main import'),
]

for fpath in files:
    p = Path(fpath)
    if not p.exists():
        print(f'SKIP: {fpath} (not found)')
        continue
    
    content = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    original = content
    
    for pattern, replacement in replacements:
        content = re.sub(pattern, replacement, content)
    
    if content != original:
        p.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
        print(f'FIXED: {fpath}')
    else:
        print(f'OK: {fpath} (no changes)')
"

"""

import csv
import logging
from io import StringIO
from typing import Optional

import psycopg2
from psycopg2.extras import RealDictCursor
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(tags=["test-classes"])

# All possible rating field names
RATING_FIELDS = [
    'rating', 'rtg', 'flam_rtg', 'flam_rating',
    'fla_rating', 'fla_firerating', 'fla_flashrating',
    'pneu_rating', 'mech_rating', 'partimp_rating', 'prom_rating',
    'cor_rating', 'elo_rating', 'ewi_rating',
    'fluc_rating', 'fluid_rating',
    'fung_rating', 'odor_rating', 'stress_rating', 'tens_rating',

]


def get_db_connection():
    """Get database connection."""
    return psycopg2.connect(
        host='localhost',
        port=5432,
        database='mira',
        user='postgres',
        password='postgres'
    )


def extract_rating(payload: dict) -> Optional[str]:
    """Extract rating value from payload using all known rating field names."""
    for field in RATING_FIELDS:
        if payload.get(field):
            return payload.get(field)
    return None


def build_rating_filter(contract_id: str, rating: str, rating_type: Optional[str] = None):
    """Build rating filter clause and params for a given contract type."""
    where_clause = ""
    params = []

    if contract_id == 'toxicity_report' and rating_type and rating_type != 'all':
        where_clause = f"(normalized_payload->>'{rating_type}' = %s)"
        params = [rating]
    elif contract_id == 'toxicity_report':
        rating_fields = [
            'tox_emurating', 'tox_orionrating', 'tox_shuttlerating',
            'tox_spacestationrating', 'tox_spacestationrtg', 'tox_rtg'
        ]
        rating_conditions = [f"(normalized_payload->>'{field}' = %s)" for field in rating_fields]
        where_clause = f"({' OR '.join(rating_conditions)})"
        params = [rating] * len(rating_conditions)
    elif contract_id == 'flash_fire_report':
        rating_fields = ['fla_firerating', 'fla_flashrating', 'fla_rating']
        rating_conditions = [f"(normalized_payload->>'{field}' = %s)" for field in rating_fields]
        where_clause = f"({' OR '.join(rating_conditions)})"
        params = [rating] * len(rating_conditions)
    elif contract_id == 'fluid_compatibility_report':
        rating_fields = ['fluc_rating', 'fluid_rating']
        rating_conditions = [f"(normalized_payload->>'{field}' = %s)" for field in rating_fields]
        where_clause = f"({' OR '.join(rating_conditions)})"
        params = [rating] * len(rating_conditions)
    else:
        rating_conditions = [f"(normalized_payload->>'{field}' = %s)" for field in RATING_FIELDS]
        where_clause = f"({' OR '.join(rating_conditions)})"
        params = [rating] * len(rating_conditions)

    return where_clause, params


@router.get("/api/test-classes/counts")
async def get_test_class_counts():
    """Get counts of unique test reports for all test classes."""
    try:
        conn = get_db_connection()
        cursor = conn.cursor(cursor_factory=RealDictCursor)

        counts = {}
        for slug, contract_id in SLUG_TO_CONTRACT.items():
            test_key = TEST_KEY_FIELDS.get(contract_id)
            if not test_key:
                counts[slug] = 0
                continue

            cursor.execute("""
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT normalized_payload->>%s) as count
                FROM silver_report_rows
                WHERE contract_id = %s
                AND normalized_payload->>%s IS NOT NULL
            """, [test_key, contract_id, test_key])

            result = cursor.fetchone()
            counts[slug] = result['count'] if result else 0

        cursor.close()
        conn.close()
        return counts

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error fetching test class counts: {e}")
        import traceback
        logger.error(traceback.format_exc())
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.get("/api/test-records/{test_type}")
async def get_test_records(
    test_type: str,
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"),
    per_page: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500, description="Records per page"),
    rating: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by rating"),
    rating_type: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Specific rating type field (toxicity only)"),
    std_test_flag: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Standard test flag filter (toxicity only)"),
    search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search material name/code"),
):
    """Get paginated test records with deduplication via DISTINCT ON."""
    contract_id = SLUG_TO_CONTRACT.get(test_type)
    if not contract_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown test type: {test_type}")

    test_key_field = TEST_KEY_FIELDS.get(contract_id)
    if not test_key_field:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"No test key mapping for {contract_id}")

    try:
        conn = get_db_connection()
        cursor = conn.cursor(cursor_factory=RealDictCursor)

        where_clauses = ["contract_id = %s"]
        params = [contract_id]

        # Rating filter
        if rating and rating.lower() != 'all':
            rating_clause, rating_params = build_rating_filter(contract_id, rating, rating_type)
            where_clauses.append(rating_clause)
            params.extend(rating_params)

        # Standard test flag filter (toxicity only)
        if std_test_flag and std_test_flag.lower() != 'all':
            where_clauses.append("(normalized_payload->>'tox_nonstandardflag' = %s)")
            params.append(std_test_flag)

        # Search filter - JOIN to materials table for designation search
        if search:
            search_sanitized = search[:100]
            search_sanitized = ''.join(c for c in search_sanitized if c.isalnum() or c in ' -_.')
            if search_sanitized.strip():
                like = f"%{search_sanitized}%"
                # Join to materials via material_code (materialkey stores material_code, not material_key)
                where_clauses.append("""
                    EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM materials m
                        WHERE m.material_code = normalized_payload->>'materialkey'
                          AND (
                              m.designation ILIKE %s
                              OR m.composition ILIKE %s
                              OR m.material_type_name ILIKE %s
                          )
                    )
                """)
                params.extend([like, like, like])

        where_clause = " AND ".join(where_clauses)

        # Count query using only %s placeholders
        count_query = f"""
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT normalized_payload->>%s) as total
            FROM silver_report_rows
            WHERE {where_clause}
        """
        cursor.execute(count_query, [test_key_field, *params])
        total_records = cursor.fetchone()['total']

        total_pages = (total_records + per_page - 1) // per_page
        offset = (page - 1) * per_page

        # Fetch records - JOIN via material_code (materialkey stores material_code, not material_key)
        query = f"""
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.normalized_payload->>%s)
                s.row_uid as id,
                s.contract_id,
                s.normalized_payload->>'materialkey' as material_code,
                s.normalized_payload,
                COALESCE(
                    m.designation,
                    CONCAT('Material ', s.normalized_payload->>'materialkey')
                ) as material_designation
            FROM silver_report_rows s
            LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.material_code = s.normalized_payload->>'materialkey'
            WHERE {where_clause}
            ORDER BY s.normalized_payload->>%s, s.row_uid DESC
            LIMIT %s OFFSET %s
        """
        cursor.execute(query, [test_key_field, *params, test_key_field, per_page, offset])
        rows = cursor.fetchall()

        records = []
        for row in rows:
            payload = row['normalized_payload'] or {}
            records.append({
                'id': row['id'],
                'material_key': row['material_code'],  # Return as material_key for API compatibility
                'material_designation': row['material_designation'],
                'test_results': payload,
                'rating': extract_rating(payload),
                'contract_id': row['contract_id'],
            })

        cursor.close()
        conn.close()

        return {
            'records': records,
            'pagination': {
                'page': page,
                'per_page': per_page,
                'total_records': total_records,
                'total_pages': total_pages,
            }
        }

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error fetching test records for {test_type}: {e}")
        import traceback
        logger.error(traceback.format_exc())
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.get("/api/test-records/{test_type}/ratings")
async def get_test_type_ratings(test_type: str):
    """Get list of available ratings for a test type."""
    contract_id = SLUG_TO_CONTRACT.get(test_type)
    if not contract_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown test type: {test_type}")

    try:
        conn = get_db_connection()
        cursor = conn.cursor(cursor_factory=RealDictCursor)

        # Choose rating fields based on test type
        if contract_id == 'toxicity_report':
            rating_fields = [
                'tox_emurating', 'tox_orionrating', 'tox_shuttlerating',
                'tox_spacestationrating', 'tox_spacestationrtg', 'tox_rtg',
                'tox_nonstandardflag'
            ]
        elif contract_id == 'flash_fire_report':
            rating_fields = ['fla_firerating', 'fla_flashrating', 'fla_rating']
        elif contract_id == 'fluid_compatibility_report':
            rating_fields = ['fluc_rating', 'fluid_rating']
        else:
            rating_fields = RATING_FIELDS[:20]  # Use subset for other types

        union_parts = [
            f"SELECT DISTINCT normalized_payload->>'{field}' as rating FROM silver_report_rows WHERE contract_id = %s"
            for field in rating_fields
        ]
        query = f"""
            WITH ratings_union AS (
                {' UNION '.join(union_parts)}
            )
            SELECT rating FROM ratings_union
            WHERE rating IS NOT NULL AND rating != ''
            ORDER BY rating
        """
        cursor.execute(query, [contract_id] * len(rating_fields))
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
        ratings = [row['rating'] for row in rows]

        cursor.close()
        conn.close()
        return {"ratings": ratings}

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error fetching ratings for {test_type}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))


@router.get("/api/test-records/{test_type}/export")
async def export_test_records(
    test_type: str,
    rating: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    search: Optional[str] = Query(None),
):
    """Export test records as CSV."""
    contract_id = SLUG_TO_CONTRACT.get(test_type)
    if not contract_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Unknown test type: {test_type}")

    try:
        conn = get_db_connection()
        cursor = conn.cursor(cursor_factory=RealDictCursor)

        where_clauses = ["contract_id = %s"]
        params = [contract_id]

        if rating and rating.lower() != 'all':
            rating_clause, rating_params = build_rating_filter(contract_id, rating, None)
            where_clauses.append(rating_clause)
            params.extend(rating_params)

        if search:
            search_sanitized = search[:100]
            search_sanitized = ''.join(c for c in search_sanitized if c.isalnum() or c in ' -_.')
            if search_sanitized.strip():
                like = f"%{search_sanitized}%"
                # Join to materials via material_code (materialkey stores material_code, not material_key)
                where_clauses.append("""
                    EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM materials m
                        WHERE m.material_code = normalized_payload->>'materialkey'
                          AND (
                              m.designation ILIKE %s
                              OR m.composition ILIKE %s
                              OR m.material_type_name ILIKE %s
                          )
                    )
                """)
                params.extend([like, like, like])

        where_clause = " AND ".join(where_clauses)

        query = f"""
            SELECT
                s.normalized_payload->>'materialkey' as material_code,
                m.designation,
                s.normalized_payload
            FROM silver_report_rows s
            LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.material_code = s.normalized_payload->>'materialkey'
            WHERE {where_clause}
            ORDER BY material_code
        """
        cursor.execute(query, params)
        rows = cursor.fetchall()

        output = StringIO()
        writer = csv.writer(output)
        writer.writerow(['Material Code', 'Designation', 'Rating', 'Contract ID'])

        for row in rows:
            payload = row['normalized_payload'] or {}
            writer.writerow([
                row['material_code'],
                row['designation'] or '',
                extract_rating(payload) or '',
                contract_id
            ])

        cursor.close()
        conn.close()

        output.seek(0)
        return StreamingResponse(
            iter([output.getvalue()]),
            media_type="text/csv",
            headers={"Content-Disposition": f"attachment; filename={test_type}-records.csv"}
        )

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error exporting test records for {test_type}: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

"""Tests for Query page API endpoints.

Module: Query (semantic material search)
Endpoint: POST /api/search

Compliance: NASA-CSET, SWE-013
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture
def client():
    """Create test client for API."""
    from mira.api.app import app
    return TestClient(app)


class TestQueryEndpoint:
    """Tests for /api/search semantic search endpoint."""

    def test_search_returns_results(self, client):
        """Search for common material returns results."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/search",
            json={"query": "stainless steel", "top_k": 10}
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert "results" in data
        assert "total" in data
        assert isinstance(data["results"], list)

    def test_search_with_polymer_query(self, client):
        """Search for polymers returns polymer materials."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/search",
            json={"query": "PTFE polymer", "top_k": 5}
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert data["total"] >= 0

    def test_search_empty_query_rejected(self, client):
        """Empty query is rejected with 422."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/search",
            json={"query": "", "top_k": 10}
        )
        assert response.status_code == 422

    def test_search_top_k_limit(self, client):
        """top_k parameter limits results."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/search",
            json={"query": "aluminum", "top_k": 3}
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert len(data["results"]) <= 3

    def test_search_result_has_material_fields(self, client):
        """Search results include required material fields."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/search",
            json={"query": "titanium alloy", "top_k": 1}
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        if data["results"]:
            result = data["results"][0]
            assert "material_key" in result
            assert "score" in result

    def test_search_default_top_k(self, client):
        """Search uses default top_k when not specified."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/search",
            json={"query": "copper"}
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        # Default is 25
        assert len(data["results"]) <= 25

"""Tests for Test Classes page API endpoints.

Module: Test Classes (test data browser)
Endpoints:
  - GET /api/test-classes/counts
  - GET /api/test-records/{test_type}
  - GET /api/test-records/{test_type}/ratings
  - GET /api/test-records/{test_type}/export

Compliance: NASA-CSET, SWE-013
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture
def client():
    """Create test client for API."""
    from mira.api.app import app
    return TestClient(app)


class TestTestClassesCounts:
    """Tests for /api/test-classes/counts endpoint."""

    def test_counts_returns_dict(self, client):
        """Counts endpoint returns dictionary of test types."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-classes/counts")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert isinstance(data, dict)

    def test_counts_has_flammability(self, client):
        """Counts include flammability test type."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-classes/counts")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert "flammability" in data
        assert isinstance(data["flammability"], int)
        assert data["flammability"] > 0

    def test_counts_has_tvs_outgassing(self, client):
        """Counts include TVS outgassing test type."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-classes/counts")
        data = response.json()
        assert "tvs-outgassing" in data
        assert data["tvs-outgassing"] > 0

    def test_counts_all_test_types_present(self, client):
        """All expected test types are present in counts."""
        expected_types = [
            "flammability", "tvs-outgassing", "toxicity", "corrosion",
            "mechanical-impact", "stress-corrosion-cracking"
        ]
        response = client.get("/api/test-classes/counts")
        data = response.json()
        for test_type in expected_types:
            assert test_type in data, f"Missing test type: {test_type}"


class TestTestRecords:
    """Tests for /api/test-records/{test_type} endpoint."""

    def test_get_flammability_records(self, client):
        """Get flammability records returns paginated data."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-records/flammability?page=1&per_page=10")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert "records" in data
        assert "pagination" in data
        assert isinstance(data["records"], list)

    def test_pagination_fields_present(self, client):
        """Pagination response has required fields."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-records/flammability?page=1&per_page=10")
        data = response.json()
        pagination = data["pagination"]
        assert "page" in pagination
        assert "per_page" in pagination
        assert "total_records" in pagination
        assert "total_pages" in pagination

    def test_record_has_material_fields(self, client):
        """Test records include material information."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-records/flammability?page=1&per_page=1")
        data = response.json()
        if data["records"]:
            record = data["records"][0]
            assert "material_key" in record or "material_code" in record
            assert "material_designation" in record

    def test_unknown_test_type_returns_404(self, client):
        """Unknown test type returns 404."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-records/nonexistent-test")
        assert response.status_code == 404

    def test_rating_filter(self, client):
        """Rating filter parameter works."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-records/flammability?page=1&per_page=50&rating=A")
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        # All records should have rating A (if any returned)
        for record in data["records"]:
            if record.get("rating"):
                assert record["rating"] == "A"

    def test_search_filter(self, client):
        """Search filter parameter works."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-records/flammability?page=1&per_page=10&search=steel")
        assert response.status_code == 200


class TestTestRecordRatings:
    """Tests for /api/test-records/{test_type}/ratings endpoint."""

        """Ratings endpoint returns list of available ratings."""

        assert "ratings" in data

    def test_ratings_not_empty(self, client):
        """Ratings list is not empty for flammability."""
        response = client.get("/api/test-records/flammability/ratings")

        assert len(data["ratings"]) > 0

        """Export endpoint returns CSV content."""

        """Export response has download filename."""

The user is asking a good question about what these tests actually do. Let me explain:
Yes, these are API endpoint tests - They use FastAPI's TestClient to make HTTP requests to the API endpoints, similar to how the frontend would call them.
They mimic the backend calls - When you click "Search" on the Query page, the frontend calls POST /api/search. These tests do the same thing.
They don't test the UI itself - They test the API layer, not the React components. To test the actual UI clicking and rendering, you'd need Playwright, Cypress, or similar browser automation.

"""Tests for Knowledge Twins page API endpoints.

Module: Knowledge Twins (H2/O2 compatibility queries)
Endpoints:
  - POST /api/query/hybrid - Hybrid evidence-first query
  - GET /api/query/health - Query engine health
  - GET /api/query/examples - Example queries

Compliance: NASA-CSET, SWE-013
"""

import pytest

def client():
    """Create test client for API."""
    from mira.api.app import app
    return TestClient(app)


class TestHybridQuery:
    """Tests for hybrid query endpoint used by Knowledge Twins."""

    def test_h2_query_basic(self, client):
        """Query H2 compatibility for a material."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/query/hybrid",
            json={
                "query": "Is 316 stainless steel compatible with hydrogen?",
                "enable_semantic": True
            }
        )
        # Should return query result or 503 if engine not loaded
        assert response.status_code in [200, 503]
        if response.status_code == 200:
            data = response.json()
            assert "status" in data
            assert "query" in data

    def test_o2_query_basic(self, client):
        """Query O2 compatibility for a material."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/query/hybrid",
            json={
                "query": "Is aluminum compatible with oxygen at 3000 psi?",
                "enable_semantic": True
            }
        )
        assert response.status_code in [200, 503]
        if response.status_code == 200:
            data = response.json()
            assert "status" in data

    def test_query_with_pressure(self, client):
        """Query includes pressure constraint."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/query/hybrid",
            json={
                "query": "titanium hydrogen 5000 psi compatibility",
                "enable_semantic": True
            }
        )
        assert response.status_code in [200, 503]

    def test_query_empty_rejected(self, client):
        """Empty query is rejected."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/query/hybrid",
            json={"query": ""}
        )
        assert response.status_code == 422

    def test_query_response_structure(self, client):
        """Query response has expected structure."""
        response = client.post(
            "/api/query/hybrid",
            json={
                "query": "inconel 718 hydrogen compatibility",
                "enable_semantic": True
            }
        )
        if response.status_code == 200:
            data = response.json()
            # Check expected response fields
            assert "status" in data
            assert "query" in data
            assert "evidence_summary" in data

"""Show BOK triage results from checkpoint database."""
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('./bok_triage_output/checkpoint.db')
cur = conn.execute(
    'SELECT file_path, doc_family, domain, routing, has_requirements, has_test_methods, page_summary '
    'FROM triage_results'
)

for row in cur.fetchall():
    # Get just the filename
    path = row[0]
    if '\\' in path:
        path = path.split('\\')[-1]
    elif '/' in path:
        path = path.split('/')[-1]

    print(f'{path[:40]:<42} | {row[1]:<18} | {row[2]:<8} | {row[3]:<14} | req:{row[4]} test:{row[5]}')
    summary = row[6] if row[6] else ''
    print(f'  Summary: {summary[:100]}...')
    print()

conn.close()

for row in cur.fetchall():

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
BOK Requirements Extractor - Phase 2
BoundState AI 2025

Extracts structured requirements from triaged documents.
Processes docs where has_requirements=True from triage phase.

Usage:
    python bok_extract.py --limit 5
    python bok_extract.py --doc-id "NASA-STD-6001B"
    python bok_extract.py --status
"""

import asyncio
import base64
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, List
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field

try:
    from anthropic import Anthropic
except ImportError:
    print("ERROR: pip install anthropic")
    sys.exit(1)

# Configuration
TRIAGE_DB = Path("./bok_triage_output/checkpoint.db")
OUTPUT_DIR = Path("./bok_extract_output")
EXTRACT_DB = OUTPUT_DIR / "extractions.db"
CACHE_DIR = Path("./bok_triage_output/render_cache")

# Model - Sonnet for better extraction quality
EXTRACT_MODEL = "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"

# Poppler path
PDFTOPPM_PATH = None
if sys.platform == "win32":
    possible_paths = [
        Path(r"C:\poppler\poppler-25.12.0\Library\bin\pdftoppm.exe"),
        Path(r"C:\Users\jwilde2\.conda\envs\boundstate-intent\Library\bin\pdftoppm.exe"),
    ]
    for p in possible_paths:
        if p.exists():
            PDFTOPPM_PATH = str(p)
            break


# =============================================================================
# EXTRACTION TOOL SCHEMA
# =============================================================================
